cancel.description: Cancel the session instead of adding a thought

conclusion.description: Required when completing a session (`nextThoughtNeeded=false` and `cancel=false`). Structured ConfessionReport. Omit when continuing or cancelling.

isRevision.description: Marks this thought as a revision of prior thinking

learn.description: Return help documentation instead of executing

needsMoreThoughts.description: Whether more thoughts are needed than originally estimated

nextThoughtNeeded.description: Whether another thought is needed after this one. `true` to continue with another thought; `false` to complete the session (requires `conclusion`) or cancel (requires `cancel=true`).

response.description: Main thought content; should include [[WikiLinks]] when helpful, but empty or omitted responses are accepted

revisesThought.description: Thought number that this revision updates

sessionId.description: Existing session identifier to continue. Omit to start a new session (system will generate one). New sessions must start with thoughtNumber=0.

submachineSessionId.description: Child session or task identifier to register as a submachine

submachineType.description: Type of child submachine to register; defaults to sequential when omitted

thoughtNumber.description: Sequence index. To start a new session, omit `sessionId` and pass `thoughtNumber=0` — the server returns the generated `sessionId`. Subsequent calls reuse that `sessionId` and increment from 1.

thoughts.description: Optional meta-thoughts; [[WikiLinks]] encouraged when provided but not required
